title: Poll truthful status in the photographer uploader

verify.summary: Compacted retained final functional PASS. Current task status is done.
Compacted final lifecycle closure: current task status is done.

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-001 RED: the existing photographer uploader stops at accepted and cannot show truthful processing/searchable progression; GREEN: a real-browser flow preserves independent accepted rows through pending, processing and ready-searchable/no_faces/failed, while incompatible/inactive ready stays explicitly not searchable and persisted state/projection membership match; decisive comparison: visible row history, exact API payloads and database eligibility agree for every terminal path; artifact: Playwright CLI transcript, screenshots/trace and redacted integration projection.
purpose: Complete the photographer-visible processing outcome by extending the existing independent uploader rows with truthful per-Photo polling.
success_outcome: Each accepted upload row independently advances through persisted pending/processing to ready-searchable, no_faces or failed, and incompatible/inactive ready never appears searchable.
anti_goals: Do not add a frontend framework, batch progress, cross-file state, inventory administration or diagnostics UI.
Do not calculate lifecycle/searchability in browser code or poll rejected/duplicate rows.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: The existing uploader row cannot retain independent status without changing accepted upload behavior.
Real-browser proof would require production data, a new UI runtime or direct browser storage/database access.

constraints: Extend the existing plain same-origin uploader page and poll only accepted photo_id values.
Consume the admission-lineage-qualified API from TASK-038; the browser does not select or combine revision rows.
Use the installed Playwright CLI through `playwright cli`; browser-free DOM/HTTP probes are not substitutes for UAT.
Use deterministic disposable Photo paths for ready, no_faces, failed and incompatible/inactive ready and clean only task-owned state.
invariants: One upload row never changes or removes another row's status.
Only the API's complete compatible truth renders as searchable.
Rejected and duplicate outcomes remain terminal uploader results and are never polled as Photos.
verification_targets: Playwright CLI UAT drives accepted Photos through ready, no_faces and failed, observes pending/processing, and proves incompatible/inactive ready remains not searchable; store transcript, screenshots and trace under the task artifact directory.
Persisted rows and projection membership are reconciled to every visible result without implementing FT-004 cosine search.
